title: The Cellar Door
journal: Never-Writes-Twice says Fort Chalkmoth is a fort like any other, but a wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in its cellar. This is my own errand, not that of my order, the Toh-Reel-Ka. The Toh-Reel-Ka's hunt for the Eye of Argonia (the old kings' jewel that can heal every sick Hist, at the Root, where the roots of every Hist meet under the sea) waits at Bell Station, whose divers know which drowned tower the marker stone shows, and either may come first. Fort Chalkmoth is the Archwardens' fort on the Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara. I'm to get into the fort and see its cellar. The keep's door opens only with the wall captain's key and cannot be picked, so he may let me in, or I may find another way in unseen.
objectives: Get into Fort Chalkmoth's keep, by the wall captain's leave or unseen. (marker: Sakeeus-Wan, Door to Fort Chalkmoth Guardroom)

plan.going: The order hunts the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every sick Hist; it lies at the Root, where the roots of every Hist meet under the sea, and the Unbound want it first. This is my own errand, to see what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth; the order's hunt, at Bell Station, is open beside it and either may come first.
plan.next: Get into Fort Chalkmoth's keep, on the mesa above Noota Nara.
plan.ways: Ask the wall captain at the gate for leave, or go in unseen by the trapdoor in the yard.

answers: I am Toh-Wo, a Secret-Speaker of the Toh-Reel-Ka, working for Nesh-Deeka under Never-Writes-Twice. A wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth. Never-Writes-Twice says it is nothing, so this is my own errand. The order hunts the Eye of Argonia at the Root, and the Bell Station lead waits for later.
Get into Fort Chalkmoth keep and see its cellar. The fort is on Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara.

Get the wall captain to let me in, since the keep door opens only with his key and cannot be picked. Or find another way in unseen. I can talk to Sakeeus-Wan, who has the quest marker, or try the Guardroom door. Illusion suits me.
I do not know who Sakeeus-Wan is, or who the wall captain is. I do not know what moans in the cellar. I can find out by talking to Sakeeus-Wan and the guards.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: The wall captain, Sakeeus-Wan, says a Toh-Wo may sleep in the barracks, but the keep stays shut to strangers while three Sarpa raiders rob the chalk carts on the western approach. I'm to kill the three raiders; then he will open the keep and pay me. I can still go in unseen by the trapdoor in the yard instead.
objectives: Kill the three Sarpa raiders on Fort Chalkmoth's western approach. (marker: Sarpa Raider, Sarpa Raider, Sarpa Raider)
Tell the wall captain the raiders are dead. (marker: Sakeeus-Wan)

plan.going: The captain will open the keep once the raiders on the western approach are dead.
plan.next: Kill the three Sarpa raiders, then tell the captain.
plan.ways: Fight the raiders (any weapon or magic), or skip the captain and go in by the trapdoor unseen.

answers: Sakeeus-Wan, wall captain, will open the keep and pay 100 gold if I kill three Sarpa raiders robbing chalk carts on the western approach. He says the order keeps its own store in the cellar and it is none of his business.
Kill the three raiders on the western approach, then report to Sakeeus-Wan.
Fight the raiders for the captain, or use the trapdoor in the yard to go in unseen, which suits my illusion build.
I do not know what the trapdoor leads to, or what the order store in the cellar holds. I can look at the yard and see.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: I killed the Sarpa raiders, and the wall captain gave me the key to the keep and a hundred gold. The stair down to the cellar starts in the quartermaster's store, inside the keep, behind a good lock; the Dunmer quartermaster, Theyne Indarys, carries its key. I'm to get into the store and go down to the cellar. I may pick the lock or lift his key.
objectives: Look at the stack of sap jars by the cellar stair in the quartermaster's store. (marker: Door to Quartermaster's Store, Theyne Indarys, Stack of Sap Jars (Jal-Veesa Knot))
Speak to the gaoler at the foot of the cellar stair. (marker: Tsleel-Vaku)
Try the cellar door. (marker: Door to Cellar Door)

plan.going: I am in the keep by the captain's leave. The cellar stair starts in the quartermaster's store.
plan.next: Three things, in any order: look in the store, speak to the gaoler at the stair's foot, try the cellar door.
plan.ways: Pick the store's Adept lock or lift the quartermaster's key; persuade the gaoler or test him with Illusion for more (optional). A theft seen, or an attack on the gaoler, sets the garrison on me.
terms: Jal-Veesa's knot: the jar's name and text; the quartermaster's line
the gaoler: his line: a gaoler of the Toh-Reel-Ka who keeps the inner door

answers: The raiders are dead and the captain gave me the keep key and 100 gold. The cellar stair starts in the quartermaster store inside the keep. The Dunmer quartermaster Theyne Indarys holds that key. The captain warns his leave covers the keep, not the store.
Go into the keep, get into the quartermaster store, look at the sap jars by the cellar stair, then go down and speak to the gaoler Tsleel-Vaku and try the cellar door.
Pick the store lock, lift Theyne Indarys key, or talk to him with illusion.
I do not know what the Jal-Veesa Knot sap jars mean, who the gaoler Tsleel-Vaku is, or what moans below. I can look at the jars and talk to the gaoler.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: Jars of Hist sap tied with the knot of the tree-minder of Jal-Veesa, the town whose sick Hist I first saw, are stacked by the cellar stair, in a fort with no Hist of its own. The order's gaoler turned me away from the inner door, Toh-Wo or not, and said Never-Writes-Twice keeps its key. Behind the door, something moans. Who is down there, and why the order feeds them sap, I cannot learn here. I'm to go back to the order's hunt for the drowned tower that Bell Station's divers know.

plan.going: The cellar holds people who moan behind a locked door, fed on sap from Jal-Veesa; Never-Writes-Twice keeps the key; why is an open question.
plan.next: Go back to the hunt at Bell Station, east of Lilmoth.

answers: The order keeps something that moans behind the cellar door of Fort Chalkmoth and feeds it Hist sap from Jal-Veesa tree-minder jars, though the fort has no Hist. The gaoler Tsleel-Vaku turned me away, and Never-Writes-Twice holds the key.
Go back to the order hunt for the drowned tower and go to Bell Station, an islet east of Lilmoth, by boat from Lilmoth.
Go to Bell Station for the divers; or later question Never-Writes-Twice about the cellar; or try the cellar door lock.
I do not know who or what is down there, or why the order hides it. I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or the Jal-Veesa tree-minder.
